description: Defines the AudioClock class providing static methods for high-resolution time retrieval and sleep functions based on POSIX clock APIs, with constants for time unit conversions.

classes.name: AudioClock
classes.description: Provides static methods for obtaining current time in nanoseconds and sleeping until a specified time or for a specified duration.

methods.name: getNanoseconds
methods.description: Returns current time in nanoseconds using specified clock (default CLOCK_MONOTONIC).

methods.name: sleepUntilNanoTime
methods.description: Sleeps until the specified absolute nanosecond timestamp; returns error code or EINTR indicator.

methods.name: sleepForNanos
methods.description: Sleeps for the specified number of nanoseconds relative to current time; returns error code or EINTR indicator.
